description: This file contains Redux reducers for managing cloud-related state in the Mattermost application, including subscription, customer, products, invoices, limits, and error states.

classes.name: LimitsReducer
classes.description: Interface defining the limits state and whether limits are loaded.

classes.name: ErrorsReducer
classes.description: Interface defining the structure for error states related to cloud entities.

methods.name: subscription
methods.description: Reducer for handling cloud subscription state based on received actions.

methods.name: customer
methods.description: Reducer for handling cloud customer data.

methods.name: products
methods.description: Reducer for managing cloud products, updating state with product list.

methods.name: invoices
methods.description: Reducer for managing invoices related to the cloud subscription.

methods.name: limits
methods.description: Reducer for managing cloud usage limits and their loaded state.

methods.name: errors
methods.description: Reducer for tracking errors in cloud data fetching and handling.
